comparison.objective: Restock a twin-roll tissue dispenser in the required stub-first sequence and lock its cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold release tabs while transferring and seating bulky rolls, clear a gate, and control a sprung cover.
comparison.success_condition: Stub engaged on reserve, new roll engaged on primary, cover latched, robot clear; swaps, drops, slams, or pinching a mis-seated roll fail.
comparison.reason: Tests sequenced hub engagement and cover closure, not percussion, notch failure, or small-part recovery.
